description: Prepares quarterly business reviews (QBRs) for customer accounts: gathers usage, value, support, and partnership metrics, shapes them into a value story, builds an ROI case the customer can validate, proposes a timed agenda, and drafts the full QBR document with forward plan and action items. Use when a CSM or account manager asks to build, prep, or draft a QBR or executive business review, summarize value delivered in a quarter, put together ROI evidence for a customer meeting, or plan the agenda for a customer review.
